title: Update 21.5 for Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central 2022 Release Wave 2
summary: Update 21.5 for Business Central 2022 Release Wave 2 includes hotfixes, feature changes for data transfer with CopyRows, and localization updates for Belgium, United States, and other regions including deferrals handling and VAT declaration updates.
features: CopyRows data transfer with SystemID and audit fields
Registration No. field for Customers and Vendors
Deferrals on local Purchase/Sales Ledger reports
EIN Number and IRS Employee Contact
